scope_notes.label: NEUC mooring jets versus northern Tsuchiya support
scope_notes.source_locator: Mean structure Results: 130 E multiple eastward jets at 8.5 N/12.5 N/17.5 N; positive velocities integrated from 26.8 sigma-theta to 900 m across 8.5-17.5 N.
scope_notes.summary: The 130 E NEUC mooring study concerns multiple subsurface jets farther north than the equatorial northern Tsuchiya cores. No alias equivalence or connecting trajectory is established; the Tsuchiya route length is not transferred. Transport integration bounds do not establish width.
